column1: # ActiveChain canonical OpenWallet conformance vectors v1.
# Independent clients must strictly decode each envelope and derive every field from it.

column5: digest384(byte) is the 48-byte string repeating that byte
shake256-384 commit over domain tag 0x0001 (canonical-value) and the canonical envelope
sd-jwt-vc=0, mdoc=1, w3c-vc=2 encoded as one unsigned byte
direct-post=0, direct-post-jwt=1, digital-credentials-api=2 encoded as one unsigned byte
offered=0, authorized=1, completed=2 encoded as one unsigned byte
the published offer is emitted in the offered state a constructor returns
configuration ids, selected credentials, and disclosed claims are strictly ascending; requested credentials are strictly ascending by (schema_id, format)
issuer_uri and response_uri are non-empty, at most 2048 bytes, and start with https://
consent.request_commitment is the canonical-value commitment over the presentation request in this vector
OpenWalletSessionV1, OpenWalletCredentialRefV1, and RequestedCredentialV1 carry no registered type tag and are only ever encoded inside an enveloped parent
